topic: vmPFC/IL 对杏仁核恐惧输出的自上而下调控：ITC 门控与 BLA 直接投射

sources.title: Neurons in medial prefrontal cortex signal memory for fear extinction
sources.key_contribution: IL神经元在消退回忆时对CS放电增强；直接刺激IL模拟消退记忆效果。消退记忆的IL编码的创始性发现。
sources.role_in_article: 背景/机制（IL-消退记忆编码）

sources.title: Electrical stimulation of medial prefrontal cortex reduces conditioned fear in a temporally specific manner
sources.authors: Milad MR, Vidal-Gonzalez I, Quirk GJ
sources.key_contribution: IL刺激减弱恐惧的时间特异性：只有与CS同步才有效，排除非特异性镇静效应。

sources.title: Amygdala intercalated neurons are required for expression of fear extinction
sources.authors: Likhtik E, Popa D, Apergis-Schoute J, Fidacaro GA, Paré D
sources.key_contribution: dermorphin-saporin选择性损毁ITC细胞→消退表达受损；r=-0.67（ITC存活数vs冻结率）。ITC细胞因果必要性的直接实验证明。
sources.role_in_article: 核心机制（ITC门控；关键数据：r=-0.67，34%损毁）

sources.title: Dissociable roles of prelimbic and infralimbic cortices, ventral hippocampus, and basolateral amygdala in the expression and extinction of conditioned fear
sources.authors: Sierra-Mercado D, Padilla-Coreano N, Quirk GJ
sources.key_contribution: IL失活损害消退记忆形成；PL失活减弱恐惧表达。双重解离确立PL/IL功能分离。
sources.role_in_article: 解剖基础（PL vs IL功能分工的行为证据）

sources.title: Fear extinction induces mGluR5-mediated synaptic and intrinsic plasticity in infralimbic neurons
sources.authors: Sepulveda-Orengo MT, Lopez AV, Soler-Cedeño O, Porter JT
sources.key_contribution: 消退训练激活IL神经元mGluR5→AMPAR插入↑+内在兴奋性↑。IL自身的消退可塑性分子机制。

sources.title: Revisiting the role of infralimbic cortex in fear extinction with optogenetics
sources.authors: Do-Monte FH, Manzano-Nieves G, Quiñones-Laracuente K, Ramos-Medina L, Quirk GJ
sources.key_contribution: 光遗传学：消退训练时沉默IL→次日消退记忆受损；消退回忆时沉默→当天恐惧重现但不影响储存。IL是写入阶段必要节点而非存储节点。
sources.role_in_article: 关键时间窗口（IL训练时 vs 回忆时的不同角色）

sources.title: Fear extinction requires infralimbic cortex projections to the basolateral amygdala
sources.authors: Bloodgood DW, Sugam JA, Holmes A, Kash TL
sources.key_contribution: IL→BLA直接投射在消退后内在兴奋性↑（IL-BLA特异，PL-BLA无此变化）；DREADD沉默IL-BLA→消退回忆受损(p=0.02)；3.4%PFC细胞同时投射BLA和NAc。
sources.role_in_article: 核心机制更新（IL→BLA直接投射的消退专门化；关键数据：3.4%双投射比例）

sources.title: Projections from Infralimbic Cortex to Paraventricular Thalamus Mediate Fear Extinction Retrieval
sources.authors: Tao Y, Cai CY, Xian JY, et al.
sources.key_contribution: IL→PVT→CeA是消退提取的独立第三通路；沉默IL→PVT投射→消退提取受损。

sources.title: Behavioral and neurobiological mechanisms of Pavlovian and instrumental extinction learning
sources.authors: Bouton ME, Maren S, McNally GP
sources.key_contribution: 系统综述消退的行为+神经生物学机制；确认PFC→BLA情绪调控多路并联模型为领域主流。

coverage_summary.human_data: 仅 Milad et al. 人类 fMRI 综述（PMID:22129456，已在 fear-extinction wiki 页记录）；本文未独立引入新的人类一手研究
coverage_summary.note: 所有PMID均经PubMed E-utilities验证返回；Milad & Quirk 2002和Milad 2004未找到PMCID，标注为摘要仅读
